messages:
maggie: Opened a PR to update the Python SDK snippets in migration-guide.md — moving examples to the new Client API. Preview CI failed (linkcheck + vale). PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1234

docs-ci: docs-preview result: FAILED
- linkcheck: 2 broken anchors (migration-guide.md#auth -> not found, migration-guide.md#examples -> changed)
- vale: 1 error (weasel words: 'easy' in migration-guide.md:42)
- md-lint: soft line-length warnings on example block

ryan: I can take the SDK snippets. ping me which examples to change, and I’ll convert the old example using `RedwoodClient` to the new `Client` API.

samir: Looks like the anchor IDs got renamed during the restructure. I’ll fix the anchors in migration-guide.md — probably changed to `#authentication-migration` and `#example-snippets`.

ellen: heads-up — I tightened a vale rule yesterday that flags 'easy' and 'obviously' in HOWTOs. Rephrase to 'recommended' or 'typical' instead.

maggie: Thanks. Plan: ryan fixes the code blocks + wording; samir fixes anchors; ellen can relax vale or confirm rewording. I’ll rerun CI and merge today EOD if green.

ryan: Found immediate issue: original snippet used tab-indented fenced block which the preview renderer collapsed. I replaced it with a fenced code block and explicit language. Example I pushed:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=\"$REDWOOD_KEY\")
print(client.generate('hello world'))
```

samir: Anchors updated and pushed: changed `#auth` -> `#authentication-migration` and `#examples` -> `#example-snippets`. Also added a short redirect note for older links.

docs-ci: Re-run queued. Current status: linkcheck PASSED, md-lint PASSED, vale: 1 warning (migration-guide.md:42 'easy' -> flagged).

ellen: I can either relax the rule for the migration-guide scope or you can reword. I prefer rewording for docs quality. Suggest: "recommended" -> "recommended approach".

ryan: I pushed a tiny wording change: replaced 'easy' with 'recommended approach' in the paragraph and tightened the example comment.

docs-ci: Final run: ALL CHECKS PASSED :white_check_mark: 

maggie: Great — @ryan can you approve when you’re ready? @samir please sanity-check the snippet output. Will merge at 18:00 PT if no objections.

ryan: Approved. LGTM. :thumbsup:

samir: Sanity-checked output locally, matches expected tokens. 

maggie: Merging at 18:00 PT. Thanks all for quick turnaround! :tada:
